Draft: island 2.2, landmark (b), pre-training by masked language modelling

The concepts the landmark needs, in style B: transbert_model (the third French model, made as the bank's two), masked_token (a hidden piece: a gap), predicted_token (the piece the model puts back: its guess) and masked_line (landmark (a)'s tokenized line with hidden places, a wrapper, landmark (a)'s concepts from the bank). The bank's general_model, flag with the translated mark, board_logo, transbert_logo, transcorpus_logo and flow_arrow are reused unchanged. First the row composing the idea; then every concept alone at whole size (a person is 360 tall), 1/3 and 1/20.

the idea, composed roughly

TransCorpus-bio-fr above, its arrow into the model's connector: it trains. Left to right: a tokenized line with ONE token hidden (a gap the size of the word), into TransBERT-bio-fr; out of it, the same line, the gap filled by the model's guess, glowing in the model's own light. Whole size, then 1/3.

the three French models

The bank's camembert_model and drbert_model, and transbert_model: one board, one badge, one place; the mascot on its badge and the French flag with the translated mark (lilac margin, the translator's sign in the corner). 250 tall, whole size.

transbert_model

TransBERT-bio-fr, the talk's own model: the bank's general model board with the TransBERT-bio-fr mascot on a badge on its top edge, and the French flag with the translated mark. CONTAINS ['general_model', 'flag', 'transbert_logo']. Alone, 250 tall.

masked_token

A masked token: the place of one token hidden from the model, a pale capsule the size of the word it hides, its outline dashed, a gap waiting to be filled. Here hiding an 8-letter word.

predicted_token

A predicted token: the token the model puts back into the gap, the same capsule of ink as any token, lit from within by a halo of the model's own light, its answer. CONTAINS ['token_bead']. The same 8-letter place, filled.

masked_line

A masked line: a tokenized line with some of its tokens hidden, each a gap the size of the token, or with those gaps filled back in by the model's guess. CONTAINS ['token_bead', 'masked_token', 'predicted_token']. Here "un infarctus du myocarde ," with "myocarde" hidden.

the masked line and the predicted line

One above the other: the line the model is shown, one token hidden; the same line with the model's guess in the gap. Whole size, then 2×. Proof: with nothing hidden, masked_line draws tokenized_line's beads byte for byte (9 of 9 calls identical, checked each time this sheet is written).
